name: Digital Transformation Arc
axiom: The core business funds the threat it cannot answer; give the answer its own room.
trigger: Enterprise transformation updates and board reporting, where the current business is both the sponsor and the obstacle.

steps.text: Dominance: the core business and its margins.
Threat: the new model growing at the edge.
Skunkworks: the protected unit allowed to compete.
Re-platform: the core moved onto what the unit proved.

antiPattern.violation: Housing the new model inside the core's roadmap, where it is ranked against the thing it is meant to replace and always loses.
antiPattern.remediation: Give the new model its own metric and its own P&L. Protection is the only thing that buys it time.

parametricParams.caption: THE CORE FUNDS ITS OWN REPLACEMENT
